title: Indoor Cat Toys and Scratchers Under $20
description: Three cat picks under $20: a wand toy with refills, XL scratcher pads, and a reversible bed. What each one is, the size, and what to check first.
dek: A wand for play, pads for the sofa, and a bed that works in summer and winter.
hook: Indoor cats need three things: something to chase, something to scratch, and somewhere to sleep. These three cover each one for under $20.
I did not test these. I read each listing and use only what it says, so check the details on the page before you buy.
skipped: Anything where the listing does not say what the item is or what size it is.
Anything that needs tools, wiring or a permanent change, for the renter and small-space guides.
how_picked: Each pick is under the price bracket shown.
The listing says what the item is and its size or capacity.
The listing gives a check or limit worth knowing before you buy.
Specs come from the listing text. Review counts and star ratings are not used here.
final: Start with the scratcher pads if the sofa is the problem. Add the wand for play, and the bed if your cat sleeps on the floor.
hero_alt: A sunny living room corner with a sofa, a terracotta throw and a ginger cat pouncing at a feather toy

picks.name: MeoHui Cat Feather Wand Toys, 2 Pack Retractable Wands with 9 Refills
picks.alt: Illustration of two retractable cat wands with feather and worm refills
picks.best_for: Daily play sessions with a cat that likes to chase
picks.limit: Refills wear out and get chewed
picks.why: Two extendable wands come with 9 refills in feather and worm styles. The listing says the refills are easy to swap when one gets chewed, so one pack covers a lot of play.
picks.con: Wands are play tools, not toys to leave out. Put the wand away after a session so a cat cannot chew the string.

picks.name: Kitty City XL 3-Pack Cat Scratcher Pads with Catnip, 10 x 18 in
picks.alt: Illustration of three flat cat scratcher pads with catnip on a floor
picks.best_for: Giving a cat a place to scratch other than the sofa
picks.why: Three flat pads, each 10 by 18 inches, with catnip. They give a cat an alternative to the sofa and are light enough to move to wherever the scratching is happening.
picks.con: Cats that prefer vertical scratching may skip a flat pad. Place one where the cat already scratches.

picks.name: WanpeeGoo Cat Cooling Mat, Reversible Warm & Cooling Cat Bed, 18" x 24"
picks.alt: Illustration of a reversible cat bed mat on a living room floor
picks.best_for: A cat bed that works across seasons
picks.limit: Check the size against your cat
picks.why: A two-sided bed: one side for summer, one for winter, at 18 by 24 inches. The listing says it is machine washable.
picks.con: Check the size against your cat before you buy, and check the washing instructions on the listing.
